description: Buy based on mean book imbalance in first 500ms of market open. Positive imbalance -> buy Up, negative -> buy Down. UTC 0-6 hours, mid-price 0.35-0.65 filter.
hypothesis: The earliest 500ms orderbook snapshots contain the most informative MM positioning before reactive flow arrives. Lowering threshold to 0.25 maintains trade count despite tighter window.
next_steps: Verdict is technically promising (53.5% WR, +$0.039/trade) but max drawdown of -$36.76 on $5.06 total PnL is severe (7:1 DD/PnL ratio). Edge is concentrated in Down trades and low-imbalance bucket [0.25,0.35). Validate on full dataset to check if edge persists. The mid-range imbalance bucket [0.35,0.50) is actually negative — consider removing it. Test with order sizing proportional to signal confidence.
